issues.description: _BufferingHandler has no max size; long-lived pre-connect period can OOM the worker
issues.detail: _BufferingHandler.buffer is an unbounded list. If a job hangs before init_recording (e.g. waiting for server assignment, slow ctx.connect, or a hung warmup), every root-logger record accumulates with no cap or eviction. A bounded deque (e.g. maxlen=1000–5000) would protect the worker from memory blowup on degenerate sessions.

issues.description: _shutdown_telemetry removes ALL LoggingHandlers from root, including unrelated ones
issues.detail: The new loop in _shutdown_telemetry iterates root handlers and removes anything that isinstance(h, LoggingHandler). If a user has attached their own opentelemetry LoggingHandler to the root logger for their own pipeline, it will be silently detached on shutdown. Track the specific handler created by _setup_cloud_tracer and remove only that one.

issues.description: _flush_early_log_buffer picks the first LoggingHandler, which may be the wrong provider
issues.detail: If multiple opentelemetry LoggingHandlers exist on the root logger (user-attached + the one just installed by _setup_cloud_tracer), the replay routes buffered crash logs into whichever appears first in handlers. The new OTLP handler should be returned/tracked by _setup_cloud_tracer and passed in directly rather than discovered by isinstance.

issues.description: _on_cleanup crash-recording path unconditionally enables logs regardless of server settings
issues.detail: Comment says "honor user-specified record settings" but _on_cleanup builds RecordingOptions(logs=True,...) unconditionally when init_recording was never reached. The server/job may have explicitly disabled log recording; this silently overrides that. At minimum gate on a flag from JobInfo/JobAcceptArguments indicating logs were requested.

issues.description: Test makefile changes drop parallelism and silently skip google STT tests with no explanation
issues.detail: unit-tests removes `-n auto` and deletes tests/test_plugin_google_stt.py from the suite. Neither change is mentioned in the PR description; losing parallelism slows CI materially and silently dropping a plugin test suite is a regression in coverage. Either restore them or document why they were removed.

issues.description: Reordering availability_resp send after registering pending_assignments — verify intent vs. server race
issues.detail: worker.py now registers `_pending_assignments[job_req.id]` before sending the availability response. This looks like a fix for a race where the server assignment arrives before the future is registered, but it's not called out in the description. Worth a one-line comment so a future reader doesn't "fix" it back.

review.summary: The crash-log buffering design is reasonable, but several rough edges deserve attention before merge: the in-memory buffer is unbounded and could OOM on stuck jobs, `_shutdown_telemetry` now removes any LoggingHandler from root rather than the one it created, and `_flush_early_log_buffer` picks the first matching handler which may not be the cloud one. The `_on_cleanup` fallback enables log recording unconditionally, contradicting the PR's "honor user-specified record settings" claim. Unrelated makefile changes drop pytest parallelism and silently exclude a plugin test file without explanation.
